item.title: September 01, 2026 - Real values
item.description: Page 255. "We become able to make wise and loving decisions based on principles and ideals that have real value in our lives." Just for Today: I am grateful for the values I've developed. I am thankful for the ability they give me to make wise, loving decisions as a responsible, productive member of my community.
